metadata.description: Agent Skills for working with Skardi — SQL pipelines as HTTP endpoints. Teaches AI coding agents Skardi's patterns for building searchable context, hybrid search, graph queries, and connectors.

plugins.name: skardi
plugins.description: Build searchable context over documents or your own datastore, answer questions from live data, query a property graph through SQL, and grow pipelines out of the queries that keep repeating. Bundles the auto-context, retrieval, graph-source, graph-rag, and skardi-query-log skills.
